topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can't believe this is happening. My application essay, out there for everyone to see, without me even knowing. I just wanted to get into college, to start fresh, and now this. It feels like every word I thought was private is splashed across the internet. What if people judge me for it? What if it changes how they see me? I need to find a way to take it down, to just...erase it. I don't know how to fix this. I keep thinking, what if they think I was trying to get attention? I wasn't. I just wrote my heart out, and now it’s on display. I have to do something, but I don’t even know where to start.
